theme: Observed daily electricity, ERA5 and source boundaries
principal_research_question: Can source-qualified SLDC daily consumption and ERA5 improve chronological retrospective inference?
minimum_original_evidence_gate: Original SLDC daily files; ERA5 original bytes; independent target-boundary audit
important_exclusion: Daily weather association not realtime forecasting; no causal temperature effect

theme: Hydro reservoirs, monsoon, flood rules and dispatchability
principal_research_question: How much reservoir flexibility survives mass balance, flood-control and physical release constraints?
minimum_original_evidence_gate: Original stage/storage curves, station inflow/releases and actual generation
important_exclusion: Do not conflate rainfall, hypothetical ramps or reservoir capacity with dispatchability

theme: Renewable deliverability, congestion, hosting and curtailment
principal_research_question: What fraction of theoretical renewable generation can be physically delivered through real constraints?
minimum_original_evidence_gate: Feeder/corridor topology and ratings; generation and metered export; curtailment instructions
important_exclusion: Exclude climate-outage resilience, siting and fossil retirement

theme: Extreme weather, physical grid damage and service restoration
principal_research_question: Can actual Kerala post-disaster outages and recovery be measured, not modeled by proxy?
minimum_original_evidence_gate: KSEB outage time logs; damage records; Mission Reconnect chronology
important_exclusion: Avoid claiming measured customer-hours or SAIDI without interruption timestamps

theme: Tariffs, DISCOM finance, affordability and subsidies
principal_research_question: Can filed and approved tariffs, booked costs and paid subsidies be reconciled meaningfully?
minimum_original_evidence_gate: KSERC orders; KSEB tariff petition/trueups; PFC accounts; survey expenditure data
important_exclusion: Proposals are not legal tariff; household bill is not welfare

theme: Land, spatial siting, biodiversity and development feasibility
principal_research_question: Where can RE projects legally, ecologically and socially be developed?
minimum_original_evidence_gate: GIS land-cover and ownership; protected boundaries; permits; public project records
important_exclusion: Resource irradiation/wind potential != developable hectares/MW

theme: Buildings, cooling, passive design and demand flexibility
principal_research_question: Which cooling/efficiency interventions produce measured energy savings under tropical comfort?
minimum_original_evidence_gate: Metered end-use and indoor thermal data; occupancy/weather and comparison groups
important_exclusion: Exclude weather-to-demand prediction and assumed adoption

theme: Road electrification, EV charging and V2G
principal_research_question: What charging chronology and infrastructure actually affect Kerala system peaks?
minimum_original_evidence_gate: Vehicle fleet stats, metered charging, station/feeder data and V2G constraints
important_exclusion: Exclude battery chemistry-only work; no observed load from registration count

theme: Industrial process heat and electrification
principal_research_question: Which process heats and industrial loads can electrify or shift cost-effectively in Kerala?
minimum_original_evidence_gate: Industrial end-use fuel/temperature and process audits; plant tariff and duty cycle
important_exclusion: Do not turn national process percentages into Kerala metered load

theme: Hydrogen, green ammonia and power-to-X
principal_research_question: Is local hydrogen useful relative to direct electrification given water, grid and cost limits?
minimum_original_evidence_gate: Electrolyser price/performance, process/offtake, renewable chronology, water rights
important_exclusion: No H2 project viability from theoretical PV potential

theme: Storage power, duration, degradation and circularity
principal_research_question: What operational storage constraints/aging/lifecycle impacts make a claimed storage value realistic?
minimum_original_evidence_gate: Power & energy capacity, lifecycle profiles, cycling calendar ageing, recycling mass balance
important_exclusion: GWh shifted annually is not installed GWh; not free dispatch

theme: Interstate power trade, balancing and market design
principal_research_question: How do actual dispatch, cross-border flows and Indian market rules affect imports and balancing?
minimum_original_evidence_gate: Grid-India/SRPC scheduled & actual flows; market price, rights, settlement and reserve data
important_exclusion: Exclude treating national capacity as real Kerala ATC

theme: Grid digitalization, sensing, control and cyber-resilience
principal_research_question: What sensing/control/protection improvements are defensible with actual network state?
minimum_original_evidence_gate: Smart meter/PMU event data, protection settings, validated network and cyber threat model
important_exclusion: Exclude merely theoretical control on unspecified feeders

theme: Biogas, municipal waste and resource recovery
principal_research_question: What net electricity and gas potential survives wet-waste seasonality, contamination and emissions?
minimum_original_evidence_gate: Waste quantity/composition, existing collection/capture, plant performance and LCA
important_exclusion: Gross tonnage is not grid-exported energy

theme: Coastal/offshore energy, ports and maritime electrification
principal_research_question: Are Kerala offshore/marine projects and shore-power uses physically and economically plausible?
minimum_original_evidence_gate: Bathymetry, ocean resource, vessel/port loads, environmental permits and grid access
important_exclusion: Do not treat national offshore resource as Kerala buildable MW

theme: Air quality, lifecycle emissions and external health effects
principal_research_question: How do complete lifecycle and exposure-adjusted impacts change Kerala energy choices?
minimum_original_evidence_gate: Technology LCA inventory, fuel provenance, ambient exposure and counterfactual generation
important_exclusion: Do not infer state-specific deaths from generic emissions factors

theme: Energy use of water supply, wastewater and pumping
principal_research_question: What operational electricity consumption/energy recovery can water utilities verify?
minimum_original_evidence_gate: Pump curves, hourly water volumes, measured kWh and wastewater methane capture
important_exclusion: Exclude reservoir-hydro flood operations

theme: Governance, public participation and just transition
principal_research_question: Which institutions/community procedures determine feasibility and equitable distribution of RE?
minimum_original_evidence_gate: Consultation records, rights/land documents, employment/demographic evidence
important_exclusion: Exclude estimating income effect without original survey

theme: Climate change futures and renewable-resource variability
principal_research_question: How sensitive are future resource and cooling futures to climate model/downscaling choices?
minimum_original_evidence_gate: CMIP6/CORDEX ensemble, model skill and bias correction, long-run weather station comparators
important_exclusion: Scenario climate cannot be relabelled historical forecast or installed generation

theme: Robust multi-sector investment planning and validation
principal_research_question: Which uncertainty and verification methods would actually change a defensible Kerala plan?
minimum_original_evidence_gate: Independent source calibration, physical constraints, compute/reproduction and uncertainty priors
important_exclusion: Avoid an optimal 2040 pathway when primary source gates remain open

theme: Agriculture, fisheries, irrigation and cold-chain end uses
principal_research_question: How much metered rural/fishery load and avoidable cold-chain waste exist under electrification?
minimum_original_evidence_gate: Sector appliance/load and irrigation/fishery output records, seasonal fuel and electricity meters
important_exclusion: Exclude assuming statewide volumes from sample equipment

theme: Coal/gas retirement, thermal flexibility and energy security
principal_research_question: Which firm/thermal contractual, flexibility and pollution costs constrain decarbonization?
minimum_original_evidence_gate: Actual contracted imports, fuel use, thermal dispatch, retirement schedules and reserve policy
important_exclusion: No reliance on simulated cost curves as real tariffs or generation

theme: Community microgrids, islanding and distributed resilience
principal_research_question: When can decentralized systems maintain critical service with actual islanding and protection?
minimum_original_evidence_gate: Event outage logs, islanding switches, local load/generation, protection and energy balance
important_exclusion: A PV+BESS toy feeder is not a measured Kerala resilient microgrid
